item.title: No. 9 Michigan women beat No. 13 Michigan State 94-91 in OT in rivals' 1st matchup as top-15 teams
item.description: Mila Holloway scored a career-high 26 points to help No. 9 Michigan outlast No. 13 Michigan State 94-91 in overtime on Sunday

item.title: Jalen Duren named reserve in 2026 NBA All-Star game, set to join Cade Cunningham & J.B. Bickerstaff
item.description: Jalen Duren has been named a reserve in the 2026 NBA All-Star Game, the league announced on Sunday evening.

item.title: Update: Missing Madison Heights 6-year-old boy with autism found
item.description: Police are searching for a missing 6-year-old boy with autism in the Madison Heights area. Michigan State Police says Johnathan Skattebo was last seen Sunday near Parliament and Hales.
